title: Remove unused EditorControls import in App.tsx
body:
## Summary
Fixes the Vercel/CI build failure `src/App.tsx(5,1): error TS6133: 'EditorControls' is declared but its value is never read.` The `EditorControls` component was imported in `src/App.tsx` but never rendered, and `tsc` (with `noUnusedLocals`) errors on it. Removed the dead import. `npm run build` (`tsc && vite build`) now passes locally.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/62853b25be014d19a12b446cc6e9d25c
Requested by: @ishaangupta-YB
